description: This file defines a class 'main_listener' that implements event handling for a phpBB extension related to 'Quick Title Edition'. It subscribes to various forum and posting events to modify topic attributes, assign user info, and handle attribute application and saving.

classes.name: main_listener
classes.description: Implements event subscriber interface to handle forum and posting events, managing topic attributes and user info display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for request, template, user, log, and qte objects.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of forum and posting events with corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: viewforum_assign_topic_attributes
methods.description: Assigns topic attribute display if topic_attr_id is present.

methods.name: viewforum_get_user_infos
methods.description: Fetches user info for topics in the list.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_title
methods.description: Modifies page title based on topic attribute.

methods.name: viewtopic_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Assigns topic attribute display and selection options.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_apply
methods.description: Applies a topic attribute to a topic based on user request.

methods.name: posting_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Handles attribute selection during post creation or editing.

methods.name: posting_submit_data
methods.description: Prepares data for saving, including attribute info.

methods.name: posting_save_attribute
methods.description: Saves attribute data to database and logs changes.
